0022600030.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, on a four-game losing streak) host the Toronto Raptors (4-4, coming off one loss) in the Bucks' ninth game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Milwaukee is 15th in the East and 5th in the Central, 5 games back, with a 1-3 home record, while Toronto is 5th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back. Kam Jones is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision for the Bucks, while the Raptors are missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes is day-to-day with groin soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bucks lost 1-3 to Toronto in the 2025-26 season, including a 122-94 home loss on February 22, 2026.
